clarity.notes: Each section reads as one idea: hero establishes the brand and offer; search-changed articulates the problem; mission reveals the philosophy word-by-word; solution presents the platform; CTA closes with two clear actions. No section overloads itself. Copy is concrete (real platform names, real feature titles) — no filler / no invented metrics.

hierarchy.notes: Display type ramps from 5xl → 8xl; the hero and mission sentences dominate. Subtitle, avatars, form, and tagline all sit clearly subordinate to the headline. Mission section's word-by-word opacity reveal creates a secondary hierarchy that pins the eye to whichever word has scrolled into view. The liquid-glass form stays readable against the dark video.

execution.notes: Inter / Instrument Serif pair is exactly the locked pairing. Letter-spacing on display headlines (-1px / -1.5px / -2px) matches the seed. Liquid-glass is implemented with the exact gradient stops from the skill (45% / 15% / 0% / 0% / 15% / 45% with 1.4px masked border). All HSL tokens emitted correctly into the production CSS. Avatar row negative spacing matches the seed (-8px). CTA background uses hls.js with Safari native fallback.

specificity.notes: Copy names the actual product (Mindloop), the actual problem (search shifted to AI conversations), the actual platforms (ChatGPT / Perplexity / Google AI), the actual features (Curated Feed / Writer Tools / Community / Distribution), and the actual actions (Subscribe Now / Start Writing). No 'Feature One', no invented stats. The mission paragraph is genuine product philosophy, not lorem ipsum.

restraint.notes: Monochrome is honored: pure black canvas, pure white text, one near-white subtitle token. No accent colors in the visible UI. The single gradient is the hero bottom fade and the liquid-glass border highlight — both load-bearing. One decisive flourish per section: word-by-word mission reveal, HLS video CTA, 3:1 aspect solution video. No competing flourishes.

P0.monochrome_only: pass — no colors beyond HSL grey ramp + hero-subtitle
P0.videos_playing: pass — hero/mission/solution MP4s autoplay/loop/muted/playsInline; CTA uses hls.js with Safari fallback
P0.data_uri_assets: pass — 3 avatars and 3 AI platform icons inlined as data:image/svg+xml;base64
P0.instrument_serif_italic: pass — .serif class used on Inspired / changed / meaningful / Journey
P0.liquid_glass_used_three_times: pass — 3 navbar social buttons, hero email form, Start Writing CTA
P0.responsive_breakpoints: pass — mobile (sm/md), tablet (md), desktop (lg) all adjust nav, grids, heading sizes, padding

P1.fadeUp_reveals: pass — IntersectionObserver via Framer Motion whileInView, margin -100px, once: true
P1.highlight_words_snap: pass — curiosity / meets / clarity snap to --foreground at progress > 0.6
P1.production_build_passes: pass — vite build emits dist/ cleanly with no warnings

P2.prefers_reduced_motion: pass — reduced motion media query strips transition/animation durations
P2.accessible_focus: pass — semantic landmarks (header/main/footer/section/nav), aria-labels on social buttons and email input
P2.selectable_text: pass — body and mission paragraphs are real DOM spans, not canvas
P2.HLS_safari_fallback: pass — code path checks Hls.isSupported() and falls back to canPlayType('application/vnd.apple.mpegurl')
